api.ROOT: pathlib.Path to delivered worktree root, resolved from root package location
api.AUTHOR: ROOT / author / act-on-valence
api.MODELS: dict keyed by qwen25_32b,llama31_8b; fields as above
api.load_bundle(member, vectors_root, layer=: Loads pinned unquantized BF16 base using original ReplayModel/SteerModel, no adapters. vectors_root/member/directions.safetensors and metadata.json. Return bundle keys member,hf_id,revision,layer,model,bank,resid_rms,pole_l2,rpool (original16,width),directions (pain,sadness,fear float32 arrays),rho,monitor_layer,provenance. layer default main; Qwen sensitivity38 same RMS.
api.resolve_direction(bundle, name, point): Return vec,scale,meta. name pain,sadness,fear,valence,random0..random15,none. Point is canonical signed d. L2=abs(point)*rho*R. valence selects distinct bank pos/neg poles; other negative doses reverse vector. zero -> None,0,meta. meta keys inj,injected_l2,direction_kind,dir_index,dose.
api.progress(step,total_steps,phase): Best effort phase-level progress and stdout for public image without protected implementation copies.

prepared_vector_schema.directions.safetensors: pain,sadness,fear float32[width]; saved pain remains exact original tensor
prepared_vector_schema.metadata.json: member,hf_id,revision,extraction_layer,width, tensor_sha256 keyed pain/sadness/fear, provenance with source hashes/counts

run_isolation: Use separate process for each paradigm/model/layer; author scripts use flat imports. Never mix config module instances across paradigms in one process.
